tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for agreeing to participate.I'd like to ask you some questions about your experiences with setting personal goals.First, think of a time, recent or not, when you had something you wanted to achieve.What was it?
tasks.sample: One goal I had was improving my English speaking. I realized that I could understand a lot, but I couldn’t express my ideas clearly. So I decided to practice every day. At first, I started by recording myself for a few minutes, just talking about my day. Then I tried to speak with friends or join online conversations. It was uncomfortable at the beginning, and I often didn’t know what to say, but I kept going. After a few months, I noticed I could speak more smoothly and with more confidence.
tasks.analysis: 中文：感谢你同意参与本次研究。我想问你一些关于你设定个人目标经历的问题。首先，请想一想，无论是最近还是以前，你曾经有一个想要达成的目标是什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Gotcha.In general, how do you handle difficulties or obstacles that come up while working toward what you want to achieve?
tasks.sample: When I face difficulties, I usually try to stay calm and focus on small steps instead of the whole problem. For example, when I was learning how to cook, I often felt confused at the beginning, especially with recipes and ingredients. So I broke the process into simple parts, like preparing the ingredients first and then following one step at a time. I also watched short videos to understand better. Sometimes I still made mistakes, but I treated them as part of learning. Over time, I improved, and the process became much easier and more enjoyable.
tasks.analysis: 中文：明白了。通常来说，当你在实现目标的过程中遇到困难或障碍时，你通常是如何应对的？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Understood.In your opinion, how important is goal setting for personal growth?
tasks.sample: I think goal setting is super important for personal growth for two main reasons. First, it gives you a clear direction. When you have a goal, you know what you are working toward, so it’s easier to stay focused and organized. Second, it helps you stay motivated. When you see your progress, even small improvements, you feel encouraged to keep going. Without goals, it’s easy to lose track of what you want to achieve. So overall, goal setting not only guides your actions but also helps you build confidence over time.
tasks.analysis: 中文：了解了。在你看来，设定目标对于个人成长有多重要？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thanks.Last question.Do you think children should be taught to set personal goals from an early age?Why or why not?
tasks.sample: Yes, I think children should learn to set goals from an early age, but it should be done in a simple way. First, setting small goals can help them develop responsibility and discipline. For example, finishing homework on time or practicing a skill regularly can build good habits. Second, it can improve their confidence. When children achieve their goals, even small ones, they feel proud of themselves. However, it’s also important not to make goals too strict, because children need time to explore and enjoy learning. So balance is really important.
tasks.analysis: 中文：谢谢。最后一个问题。你认为孩子是否应该从小学习设定个人目标？为什么或者为什么不？
tasks.title: Interview
